Shanghai Municipal Council.
4th October 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
It is reported that the Arsenal Authorities have received orders from Peking to manufacture as many machine guns as possible.

The City and Chapoi Police were paid on the 3rd inst. The troops will be paid on the 5th inst.

The officers of the Arsenal who are forming a committee to assist the more destitute of the rebels have opened a temporary office at 41 Dau Tuh Li 道德里 Frenchtown.

The rebels propose to celebrate the inauguration of the Republic on the 10th inst at the Koo Ka Za 顾家宅 Gardens. At the same time they propose to honour the French Consul General for his protection during the past and also to have a lantern procession in the city.

It is reported that Han Hwe, the Labour leader, has written three strong and rather impertinent letters to the City Magistrate whom he requests to assist several of the master painters and thus force them to bring to an end the present dispute.

Those of the rebels who are destitute are much dissatisfied at the delay in distributing the repatriation funds which are not yet available. Some of them threaten violent measures if the distribution does not commence soon.

Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（签名）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。
1916年10月4日
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

据报，兵工厂当局已接到来自北京的命令，要求尽可能多地制造机枪。

华界与闸北警队已于本月3日发饷。部队将于本月5日发饷。

兵工厂内正组建一个委员会以援助叛军中更为贫困者的军官们，已在法租界道德里41号开设了一间临时办公室。

叛军拟于本月10日在顾家宅花园庆祝共和国成立。同时，他们提议向法国总领事致谢，感谢其过往提供的保护，并计划在城内举行灯笼游行。

据报，劳工领袖韩惠（音译）已向华界知事写了三封措辞强硬且相当无礼的信件，请求知事协助几位油漆行老板，从而迫使他们结束当前的纠纷。

那些生活困窘的叛军对遣散费发放延迟极为不满，目前该款项尚未到位。其中一些人威胁称，若不久后开始发放，他们将采取暴力手段。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
首席侦探督察。

（签名）
警务处总监。
